decision_text: A later Owner-GO may authorize one read-only GET only after a governed rebind of EXPECTED_ORIGIN_MAIN_SHA to the then-current origin/main, an explicit choice that the credential source is the K1 keychain rather than the canary vault URI, and a governed eligibility fact. This pass does not perform that GET.

executor.producer_result_when_observation_exists: ELIGIBILITY_FACT_MISSING and no minted sizing value

intended_source.identity_check: observed uid must match REUSED_BINDING_ACCOUNT_SCOPE or ACCOUNT_IDENTITY_SCOPE_MISMATCH
intended_source.numeric_rule: non-negative finite decimal; NaN Infinity scientific notation and empty fail closed
intended_source.stale_rule: age < 0 or age > max_age or max_age > 5 appends OBSERVATION_STALE

path: GET /api/v5/account/balance -> exactly one USDC details.availEq -> observation -> P01 fact -> produce() with eligibility None -> fail closed -> capital guard never receives a fresh value -> reservation not created
